check_manifest <- function(path, family, expected_sha256) {
    manifest_path <- absolute_path(path)
    manifest <- read_stored_csv(path)
    assert_columns(manifest, c("path", "sha256", "bytes", "producer", "artifact_type"), paste(family, "manifest"))
    manifest_sha256 <- digest::digest(file = manifest_path, algo = "sha256")
    stopifnot(identical(manifest_sha256, expected_sha256))
    listed_paths <- absolute_path(manifest$path)
    present <- file.exists(listed_paths)
    current_bytes <- rep(NA_real_, length(listed_paths))
    current_sha256 <- rep(NA_character_, length(listed_paths))
    current_bytes[present] <- file.info(listed_paths[present])$size
    current_sha256[present] <- vapply(listed_paths[present], function(file) digest::digest(file = file, algo = "sha256"), character(1))
    summary <- tibble::tibble(Family = family, `Manifest path` = path, `Manifest SHA-256` = manifest_sha256, `Files listed` = nrow(manifest), `Files present` = sum(present), `Size checks` = sum(present & current_bytes == manifest$bytes), `SHA-256 checks` = sum(present & current_sha256 == manifest$sha256), Check = ifelse(all(present & current_bytes == manifest$bytes & current_sha256 == manifest$sha256), "PASS", "FAIL"))
    stopifnot(summary$Check == "PASS")
    list(data = manifest, summary = summary)
}

    output
}

verify_artifact_manifest <- function(path, superseded_paths = character()) {
    manifest <- read_h01_csv(path)
    stopifnot(all(c("path", "sha256") %in% names(manifest)))
    files <- file.path(root, manifest$path)
    stopifnot(all(file.exists(files)))
    observed <- unname(vapply(files, artifact_sha256, character(1)))
    mismatched <- manifest$path[observed != unname(manifest$sha256)]
    stopifnot(setequal(mismatched, superseded_paths))
    manifest
}

verify_production_integration_manifest <- function(path, current_transition_paths) {
    manifest <- read_h01_csv(path)
    stopifnot(all(c("path", "sha256") %in% names(manifest)))
    files <- file.path(root, manifest$path)
    stopifnot(all(file.exists(files)))
    observed <- unname(vapply(files, artifact_sha256, character(1)))
    historical_verifier <- manifest$path == "tests/hypotheses/H01/test_h01_l10_METRIC011_production.R"
    current_transition <- manifest$path %in% current_transition_paths
    mismatched <- observed != unname(manifest$sha256)
    stopifnot(sum(historical_verifier) == 1L, setequal(manifest$path[mismatched], manifest$path[historical_verifier | current_transition]))
    manifest
}

format_effect_values <- function(estimate, lower, upper, effect_scale, metric_slot, result_status) {
    result <- rep("—", length(estimate))
    non_estimable <- result_status == "NON_ESTIMABLE_COMPONENT_FAILURE"
    result[non_estimable] <- "Not estimable"
    mder <- metric_slot == 15L & !is.na(estimate)
    result[mder] <- sprintf("%+.3f (%+.3f to %+.3f)", estimate[mder], lower[mder], upper[mder])
    ratio <- grepl("ratio", effect_scale, fixed = TRUE) & !mder & !non_estimable & !is.na(estimate)
    result[ratio] <- sprintf("%.2f× (%.2f to %.2f)", estimate[ratio], lower[ratio], upper[ratio])
    absolute <- !ratio & !mder & !non_estimable & !is.na(estimate)
    result[absolute] <- sprintf("%+.2f h (%+.2f to %+.2f)", estimate[absolute], lower[absolute], upper[absolute])
    result
}
